name: vines
prompt: A dense curtain of long hanging swamp vines and grey-green Spanish moss draped from a horizontal wooden beam, many thin ropey vines with small dark green leaves dangling straight down at different lengths, some with tiny glowing yellow-green buds, the beam short and mostly hidden by moss, flat and wide like a hanging curtain, fantasy bayou decoration.

name: ivy
prompt: A large flat patch of climbing ivy and moss growing on a wall, thick dark green leafy ivy spreading upward and sideways with trailing tendrils and a few hanging strands at the bottom, flat back as if pressed against a wall, overgrown swamp style, game decoration.

name: gable
prompt: A rustic swamp lodge roof gable, front view: a steep pitched roof of weathered dark wooden shingles over a timber gable end of rough vertical planks, one large warm glowing arched window with wooden mullions in the middle, chunky rough-hewn timber beams and carved wooden bargeboards along the roof edges, thick green moss on the shingles and long swamp vines and Spanish moss hanging off the eaves, a small black iron lantern with a warm flame hanging from the peak, old Louisiana bayou cabin style, no towers, no spires, no metal.

name: window
prompt: A rustic swamp lodge window, front view, tall with a rounded arched top: a chunky weathered dark wooden frame with rough-hewn timber trim and a small carved keystone, wooden mullions dividing small glass panes that glow with warm golden candle light from inside, a thick wooden sill with green moss and a small trailing vine, two old wooden shutters slightly open on the sides, Louisiana bayou cabin style, flat back as if set into a wall.
